settings.title: A Department Dedicated to Culture and Social Participation

settings.editor:
The Cultural and Social Engagement Department is one of the three statutory departments of Association Amal Chabab Takaddoum. It supports the orientations relating to culture, engagement and social participation.

The association's purpose, as set out in its statutes, includes promoting development, cultural, social and sports activities that benefit the young people of Rabat.

In accordance with the statutes, the organization of the working departments and the monitoring of program implementation fall under the supervision of the Executive Board, elected by the General Assembly.
The department's activities are organized around three complementary areas.

Promoting cultural, artistic, film-related and sports activities is among the areas of intervention provided for in the association's statutes. These activities are envisaged as spaces for expression, learning, meeting and participation.
Engagement refers to the collective initiatives the association envisages as spaces for meeting, participation and community connection.
Social participation refers to people's involvement in collective life. The statutes provide for fostering a spirit of cooperation and solidarity within civil society.

settings.title: A Cross-Cutting Contribution to the Other Departments

settings.editor:
The department's contribution extends beyond its own scope: it also helps create the conditions in which the other two statutory departments carry out their activities.

Meeting spaces and collective initiatives connect with the learning and integration orientations supported by the Training and Integration Department, while the Administration and Management Department contributes to the organization and resources needed to carry them out.

This coordination takes place within the framework established by the statutes, with the Executive Board overseeing the organization of committees and working departments, as well as monitoring the implementation of established programs.

settings.title: The Principles That Guide Its Work

settings.editor: The department's work is guided by the principles that shape the association's commitment.
Making a commitment through a serious and constructive approach.
Recognizing talents, ideas and the capacity to take action.

Overall orientations are determined by the General Assembly, their supervision is entrusted to the Executive Board, and committees contribute to reviewing programs and monitoring activities within their respective areas of work.
The association's organization is based on three complementary statutory departments.
